exposure: provision of training to trainee doctors at the maternity facility
type III (maximum care level) maternity facilities
Provision of training to trainee doctors
Maternity facility type (private vs. public, level of care)
cohort: 250,564 women who gave birth in the South of France
finding: Audits concerning cesarean delivery and the provision of training to trainee doctors were associated with a decrease in the cesarean delivery rate.
mod_finding: The caesarean delivery rate was significantly higher in private maternity facilities and type III (maximum care level) maternity facilities.
